ينتزعان (form VIII)
# يَنْتَزِعَانِ (yantaziʕāni) /jan.ta.zi.ʕaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# يُنْتَزَعَانِ (yuntazaʕāni) /jun.ta.za.ʕaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
